column2: (7) Where any member is temporarily unable to perform

column1: the duties of his office on account of ill health, absence from
Sri Lanka or any other cause, the Minister may appoint any
person to act in place of such member.

column2: A person shall be disqualified from being appointed,

column1: or from continuing, as a member if he—

column2: is a Member of Parliament, a member of a Provincial
Council or a member of a local Authority; or
is under any law in force in Sri Lanka or in any other
country found or declared to be of unsound mind;
is a person who, having been declared an insolvent
or a bankrupt under any law in Sri Lanka or in any
other  country,  or  is  an  undischarged  insolvent  or
is serving or has served a sentence of imprisonment
imposed by any Court in Sri Lanka or abroad.
No act or proceeding of the Board shall be invalid by

column1: reason only of any vacancy among its members or any defect
in the appointment of any of its members.
